title: Clinical and Morphological Bone Marrow Characteristics of Pearson Syndrome: About Three Consecutive Cases and Review of the Literature.
authors: Degroot GN, Empain A, Dedeken L, Demulder A, Demulder A, Rozen L.

Onset characteristics of PS patients. (a) Distribution of the age of onset in 157 patients. (b) The percentage of affected systems at onset. (c) The percentage of symptoms observed at onset (PEI, pancreatic exocrine insufficiency).
